name: Forumax – AI Powered Advanced Community Forum Plugin
author: Spider Themes

sections.description:
Forumax is the ultimate standalone community forum solution for WordPress. Designed for forum administrators, content creators, and community managers, Forumax provides a complete suite of powerful features to create professional, engaging forums with minimal effort—no external forum dependencies required.

What is Forumax?

Forumax provides a complete, self-contained platform for building support forums, knowledge bases, or discussion communities. It includes everything you need to foster engagement, manage content effectively, and create an exceptional user experience right out of the box.

Key Features of Forumax

🎯 Unified Forum Builder
Take complete control of your forums with our intuitive, built-in builder. View all forums and topics in one organized dashboard, filter by status (open, closed, pending, spam), and manage discussions efficiently without navigating multiple pages.

🔐 Private & Confidential Replies
Enable users to post private responses visible only to forum owners and moderators. Perfect for sensitive discussions, support tickets, and confidential advice while maintaining full transparency where needed.

✅ Solved Topics System
Help community members quickly identify answered questions. Mark topics as solved to display a prominent ‘Resolved’ badge, reducing duplicate questions and improving user experience. Visitors instantly know which topics have solutions.

⭐ Smart Voting & Reputation System
Empower your community with a built-in AJAX-powered voting system. Users vote on the most helpful replies, automatically elevating quality answers to the top. Build reputation-based authority and encourage quality contributions.

📎 Media Attachments & File Sharing
Allow users to attach files, documents, images, and media directly to replies. Organized attachment sections make it easy for community members to share resources, code snippets, documents, and collaborate effectively.

💡 Advanced Forum Statistics Widget
Display real-time forum information including topic count, reply count, last activity, and most active users. The ‘Current Forum Info’ widget provides visitors with a quick overview of forum vitality and engagement.

🎨 Elementor Page Builder Integration
Create stunning forum layouts using Elementor’s drag-and-drop builder. Use specialized Forumax widgets to display forums, topics, and replies on any page with full customization control. No coding required.

⚡ Lightweight & Performance-Optimized
Forumax is built for speed. It loads assets intelligently—CSS and JavaScript only when needed. Minimal footprint ensures your forum runs fast without bloat.

🔧 Intuitive Admin Interface
Create, edit, and delete forums and topics directly from the Forumax admin dashboard. Streamlined interface eliminates confusion and reduces admin overhead.

Free Features:

  • Live Customizer – Instantly preview and customize forum styles with real-time visual controls.

  • Pre-made Templates – Start quickly using professionally designed forum templates for common use cases.

  • Unified Forum Builder – Build and manage forums, topics, and layouts from one centralized builder.

  • Voting on Topics & Replies – Allow users to upvote or downvote topics and replies for engagement.

  • Solved Topic – Mark topics as solved to highlight correct answers and improve usability.

  • Frontend Brand Color Option – Customize forum brand colors directly from frontend settings easily.

  • Who Can Upload Files – Control user roles and permissions for uploading files in forums.

  • Pagination in Forum Builder – Manage large forums efficiently with built-in pagination support.

PRO Features – Everything You Need for Advanced Community Management:

Upgrade to Forumax Pro for enterprise-grade forum management:

  1. Real-Time Admin Notifications – Stay updated with instant dashboard alerts for new posts, moderation requests, and community activity.

  2. Smart User Notifications – Keep members engaged with real-time updates on subscribed forums, topics, and replies they care about.

  3. Mini User Profiles – Display compact user profile cards with activity summaries, follower counts, and quick-view reputation.

  4. Pre-Built Elementor Templates – Import professional forum layouts with one click. Fully customizable templates for forums, knowledge bases, and support centers.

  5. “I’ve the Same Question” Feature – Reduce duplicate threads by letting users indicate similar questions, improving forum organization.

  6. Anonymous Posting – Allow sensitive discussions without revealing user identity. Ideal for support forums and confidential advice.

  7. Dynamic User Profile Links – Generate personalized profile URLs for logged-in users. Perfect for user bios and contributor pages.

  8. Topic Approval Workflow – Control content quality with admin-approval for new topics. Prevent spam and maintain forum standards.

  9. Advanced File Management – Support multiple file uploads with increased size limits. Delete attachments independently or with content.

  10. Powerful Voting Controls – Guest voting restrictions, prevent closed-topic voting, disable self-voting, admin voting privileges, and vote-based sorting.

  11. External Image Insertion – Insert images via URL or media library picker. Enhance replies with visual content effortlessly.

  12. Auto-Approval System – Automatically publish reply replies instantly. Streamline moderation workflows and maintain conversation flow.

  13. Attachment Moderation – Approve/unapprove replies containing files for enhanced content security and compliance control.

Promax Features:

Reply Timeline Navigation
Automatically loads more replies when users scroll down. A reply timeline is visible beside the replies to help users follow long discussions easily.

Live Chat
Adds a private real-time chat system. A chat icon is visible on the right side of the site to open the chat box. Admins can set default assistants from the settings. Users can chat with the assistant or with forum participants. Messages support likes, replies, emojis, and file or video sharing. Chat can also be started by hovering over forum, topic, or reply users.

Emoji for Topics and Replies
Allows users to add expressive emojis to forum topics and replies, making conversations more engaging, emotional, and easier to understand.

Real-Time Alerts
Displays instant notifications when new topics are published or existing discussions are updated, keeping users informed without refreshing the page.

Social Login
Allow users to sign up and log in instantly using Google, Facebook, or Twitter, reducing friction and increasing overall registration conversion rates.

Analytics
Get powerful insights into forum performance with real-time statistics, activity trends, user engagement metrics, and resolution data—all presented in a clear, actionable dashboard view.

AI Integration (via Our AI Plugin)

Forumax can be extended with powerful AI capabilities using the AI Tools, designed to automate support workflows, improve engagement, and transform forum discussions into valuable long-term content.

Important: AI features require the Antimanual AI Plugin and an active AI provider connection.

AI-Powered Forum Replies

Instantly generate intelligent, context-aware replies to forum topics. Improve response time, reduce moderator workload, and maintain consistent support quality across your community.

Ideal for:

  • Support forums
  • Product discussions
  • Knowledge-sharing communities

Convert Solved Topics into Posts

Automatically convert resolved forum topics into structured WordPress posts.

Each generated post can include:

  • Problem summary
  • Accepted solution
  • Key insights and takeaways

This feature turns your forum into a living knowledge base while improving SEO and long-term content value.

Smarter Community Management

By combining Forumax core features with AI automation, moderators can:

  • Reduce repetitive replies
  • Scale support without increasing team size
  • Keep forums clean, searchable, and helpful

Forumax + AI transforms discussions into long-term assets.

Video Overview

Note: We have renamed our plugin from BBP Core to Forumax. All features previously available in BBP Core are still here and fully supported.

Important: After updating to version 2.0.0, the plugin will be renamed to forumax. This may cause WordPress to deactivate the plugin. If deactivated, please simply reactivate it.

  • Security First: Built with WordPress security best practices
  • Scalable Solution: Handles small communities to large enterprise forums
  • Beginner-Friendly: Intuitive UI requires no technical knowledge

sections.installation:
Getting started with Forumax is quick and easy. Follow these simple steps:

Prerequisites

Before installing Forumax, ensure you have:
* WordPress 5.0 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or greater
* MySQL 5.6 or greater

Installation Method 1: Install from WordPress Admin Dashboard (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Forumax” in the plugin search box
  3. Click the Install Now button
  4. After installation completes, click Activate Plugin
  5. Navigate to Forumax → Settings to configure features (optional but recommended)
  6. Start building your community!

Installation Method 2: Manual Upload via FTP/cPanel

  1. Download the forumax.zip file from the plugin page
  2. Extract the ZIP file on your computer
  3. Upload the extracted forumax folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP or cPanel File Manager
  4. Go to Plugins in your WordPress admin and locate Forumax
  5. Click Activate Plugin
  6. Configure settings in Forumax → Settings

Installation Method 3: Upload ZIP from WordPress Admin

  1. Download the forumax.zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Select the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. After installation, click Activate Plugin
  5. Configure your forum settings

Troubleshooting Installation

Getting PHP errors?
Verify your PHP version is 7.4 or higher. Contact your hosting provider to upgrade if needed.

Still need help?
Visit our Documentation or check our Support Repository
sections.faq:
🎯 Who Should Use Forumax?

Forumax is perfect for WordPress site owners, community managers, support teams, and anyone who wants a professional forum solution without custom coding.

🔄 Is Forumax Compatible with My Theme?

Yes! Forumax works seamlessly with any WordPress theme.

💻 Do I Need Coding Skills?

Absolutely not! Forumax is designed for non-technical users. All features are accessible through intuitive admin interfaces and visual builders. No coding required.

🎨 Can I Customize the Forum Layout?

Completely! With Elementor integration, you can drag-and-drop customize forum layouts. Pre-built templates and full styling options give you unlimited design flexibility.

📦 What Version of WordPress Do I Need?

Forumax requires WordPress 5.0 or higher and PHP 7.4 or greater.

⚙️ Is Forumax Performance Optimized?

Yes. Forumax only loads necessary assets when needed, ensuring minimal impact on site performance and fast loading times.

🐛 How Do I Report Bugs or Get Support?

Found an issue? Report it on our GitHub repository. For detailed help, visit our Documentation.

💪 What Features Are in the Pro Version?

Forumax Pro adds advanced features like real-time notifications, pre-built templates, anonymous posting, advanced attachments, topic approval workflow, and more. Check Pro pricing →

🤖 Does Forumax include AI features?

Forumax supports AI-powered features through the our AI Plugin. This allows AI-generated replies, Convert Resolved Topics into Posts etc.
